workflow.entry: Run source_validation.py from the reviewed workflow checkout with python -I, from runner.temp. Verify exact Git HEADs and the fixed four-file transport closure hashes before invoking capture_isolation.py with python -I using its unchanged reviewed CLI. Validate source roots and prevent overlap. Subject source remains untrusted data on the host. The transport receives a separate wrapper-owned0600 GITHUB_OUTPUT file outside candidate/trusted/container-writable/output roots, with a small explicit byte cap. The wrapper parses only a single exact artifact_root assignment and rejects duplicate, unknown, multiline, unsafe or excessive output. Admit only the expected generated atk-visual-<hexuuid> direct child of actual RUNNER_TEMP, with no symlink/hardlink/non-directory/root overlap and ownership/path-component checks. Never fall back to a guessed root when transport suppresses output after unsafe writers. Only the wrapper emits its admitted path to the Actions command file; an independent wrapper-owned source-validation metadata directory can be retained safely when no capture root is admitted. No transport-root files are exposed before this admission.
workflow.environment: Build an explicit child environment containing only required PATH, RUNNER_TEMP, GITHUB_OUTPUT and repository/run/attempt/CANDIDATE/CANDIDATE_ROOT identities. Do not forward GitHub/App tokens, Git extraheaders/config, proxies, private credentials or uncontrolled Python import variables. The fixed transport handles owned install egress guards, a nonroot install container, network-none rendering, complete streams, uncertainty checks and cleanup.

Explicit false approval/activation fields and distinct role/name; never synthetic-probe, production admission, visual approval, main or runtime receipt.
